title: B2 negative-leg comment mis-states the rejection distance: the bad place (13,10) is 1 tile from the fixture router, not 2
detail: (13,10)−(12,10) gives d²=1, i.e. 1 tile, not the documented 2. The rejection itself is correct (1 < 4 floor), but the stated rationale and the (2 < 4) message are factually wrong.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment and expectf message to '1 tile from the fixture router (1 < 4)'; no behavior change needed.

title: Garbled comment in draw_building fallback path — 'belt-and-) braces' splits the idiom with an unbalanced paren
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:755-757:  	// from it); the fills stay opaque (the unreachable path is belt-and-)
	// braces, the wash/chip ride the same fade as the sprite path.
detail: The line-wrap closed the parenthetical mid-idiom ('belt-and-) braces'), leaving an unbalanced paren in a comment this diff added.
